newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-JUVENTUS LOSE DEL PIERO FOR MONTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-JUVENTUS LOSE DEL PIERO FOR MONTH.

text.p: Italy international Alessandro Del Piero, an inspirational figure for Juventus this season, will be sidelined for at least a month after pulling a thigh muscle in training on Wednesday.
Italian television said Del Piero, who scored his 50th goal for the club at the weekend, would need a month's rest before he could start training.
The club were unavailable for comment.
If the layoff proves that long Del Piero will miss both legs of his club's European Cup quarter-final against Norwegian club Rosenborg next month as well as key league fixtures.
Juventus, who play Italian Cup finalists Vicenza at home on Saturday, are five points clear at the top of the league.
The injury to Del Piero is the latest of many blows to hit the European Cup holders in recent days.
Croat striker Alen Boksic, a powerful force early in the season, has not played since January 12 after suffering an ankle injury and looks doubtful for the weekend game.
French internationals Zinedine Zidane and Didier Deschamps are also unavailable because of suspension and injury respectively, while captain Paolo Conte has been sidelined for four months.
First choice Italy goalkeeper Angelo Peruzzi is doubtful for the Vicenza clash because of a back injury.
